S.I. No. 285/2003 - Rules Made Pursuant To The Provisions of Section 25 (A) of the Medical Practitioners Act, 1978, As Inserted by The Medical Practitioners (Amendment) Act, 2002

  • AmendmentsLeasuithe

Rules made pursuant to the provisions of section 25 (A) of the Medical Practitioners Act, 1978 , as inserted by the Medical Practitioners (Amendment) Act, 2002 :- Medical Council Rules prescribing bodies to grant Certificate of Experience, and prescribing period per section 28 (1) (b) and section 28 (2) of the Act.

Dublin

Published by the Stationery Office

Rules made pursuant to the provisions of section 25 (A) of the Medical Practitioners Act, 1978 , as inserted by the Medical Practitioners (Amendment) Act, 2002 .

1.   These rules are made pursuant to the provisions of section 25 (A) of the Medical Practitioners Act 1978 , as inserted by the Medical Practitioners (Amendment) Act, 2002 , for the purpose of specifying the prescribed bodies referred to in section 28(1)(b) which may grant a Certificate of Experience and the prescribed period referred to in section 28 (2) of the Medical Practitioners Act 1978 .

3.        Prescribed period(s) of employment under section 28(2)

For the purpose of section 28(2), a prescribed period of employment is a period of not less than 12 months, which should be consecutive, of which at least 3 months must be spent in Medicine in general and 3 months in Surgery in general. As part of this 12 month period, a person may also be employed for not less than 2 months and not more than 3 months in the following specialties:

Emergency Medicine

Obstetrics and Gynaecology

Paediatrics

Psychiatry
